purpose: Expected global Codex contour for this source_of_truth pack.

forbidden: Do not edit auth.json, session files, sqlite logs, credentials, or unrelated skill folders.
Do not install broad MCP/plugin sets without explicit task value.
Do not paste full installed skill maps into AGENTS.md or AGENTS.override.md.

source_policy.missing_source_behavior: Do not install. Mark BLOCKED or DEGRADED and update the registry with a real source first.
source_policy.plugin_availability: Enabled plugin config is intent only. Availability requires a matching plugin cache .codex-plugin/plugin.json.
forbidden: Do not invent GitHub repositories from capability names.
Do not reconstruct installable skills from installed snapshots.
Do not add MCP servers from random package search without first declaring source, package, command and approval requirement.

global_files.expected: Russian by default, terse style, KISS, no overcoding, skill routing via live registry, safe global edits.
May exist, but should not compete with project-local AGENTS.md or duplicate huge skill catalogs.

global_files.role: Codex config, plugins and MCP servers
global_files.expected: Contains only useful MCP/plugin entries and no committed secrets.

notes: Global Codex files are runtime configuration, not the public source of truth.
Install sources live in registries/capabilities.json sources[], not in chat memory.
This repository should generate proposals and audit reports before any global write.
Global edits require explicit user approval and backup.
